observed_facts.internet_banking_2025: Eurostat states that across most Romanian regions, except Bucuresti-Ilfov, fewer than one in three people aged 16-74 used internet banking in the previous three months. This includes all three AI4WORK target NUTS2 regions.
observed_facts.daily_internet_trend_2019_2024: Eurostat states that daily internet use increased more rapidly in regions where it was initially low, particularly in Romania.

promoted_source.claim_boundary: Internet banking and daily internet use are usage behaviours, not measurements of digital/AI competence, skill-gap prevalence or training demand. The Eurostat population is age 16-74, not the AI4WORK eligibility frame. The source-exact threshold statement is not converted into invented regional percentages.

secondary_research.research_boundary: Only source-exact official/institutional facts are registered. Secondary evidence, policy activity and training supply remain excluded from deterministic H1-H5 scoring.
